repo.name: Quick Vault Retriever
primary_users: People with a local JSONL-first knowledge vault
Raycast users who need immediate evidence in their current workflow
Developers integrating a bounded local retrieval primitive
repo.product_surface: A read-only Python CLI and thin Raycast Script Command over a compatible SQLite FTS5 projection.

architecture.system_context: A local retrieval surface between Raycast or a shell and a derived JSONL Vault SQLite projection.
data_flow: An arbitrary natural-language query enters through Raycast or the terminal.
The CLI validates and tokenizes the query without persisting it.
The retriever opens the projection in immutable query-only mode.
Compatibility and ledger freshness are checked before FTS retrieval.
Coverage-ranked bounded snippets leave as a versioned cited evidence packet.
trust_boundaries: Private query and SQLite projection remain local.
Canonical JSONL and its writer are outside process authority.
Public Git contains only source, contracts, documentation, and synthetic fixtures.
Any future model provider is a separate opt-in boundary.

vision.one_line: Fast, bounded, source-cited evidence from a local JSONL Vault without waking a general-purpose agent.
vision.north_star: Make private local knowledge as fast and dependable to query as a calculator, without turning retrieval into an unbounded agent.
vision.promise: Turn a natural-language vault query into inspectable, source-cited evidence in seconds while preserving local ownership and safe abstention.
vision.wedge: A read-only Python CLI and Raycast Script Command over an existing SQLite FTS5 projection.
assumptions: The caller has a locally accessible compatible SQLite FTS5 projection.
Stable JSONL record IDs are meaningful citations for local use.
A bounded evidence result is useful without conversational synthesis.
The canonical ledger can be read to enforce projection freshness.
success_criteria: Warm retrieval p95 is below 1000 ms on the target Mac.
Every successful hit includes a stable record citation.
Missing evidence produces not_found with no fabricated answer.
Fresh-clone setup and make check succeed from documented commands.
No private record, absolute vault path, secret, or generated runtime artifact is tracked.

principles.title: A bounded product surface for humans and agents
principles.rule: Return a small versioned evidence packet that is easy to inspect and safe to compose.

principles.title: Machine-readable contracts before prose interpretation
principles.rule: Version evidence and vision contracts as JSON and validate them locally.

principles.title: Fast failure beats plausible invention
principles.rule: Expose missing, partial, stale, or incompatible evidence rather than guessing an answer.

principles.title: Retrieval never becomes mutation
principles.rule: Open the derived projection immutable and query-only while keeping the canonical writer outside process authority.

principles.title: Questions are broader than entities
principles.rule: Treat contact lookup as one query class among decisions, projects, events, tasks, sources, and other records.

principles.title: Use the cheapest deterministic path first
principles.rule: Query the existing local FTS projection before considering optional model synthesis.

non_goals: Mutating canonical JSONL or human-owned notes
Producing or repairing the SQLite projection
Shipping cloud or local-model synthesis in version 0.1
Optimizing exclusively for contacts, people, or entity properties

forbidden: Real vault records or database copies
Personal names, addresses, private queries, or screenshots
Credentials, tokens, environment files, or key material
Generated reports, caches, and local benchmark corpora
required_boundaries: Only synthetic SQLite fixtures may be committed.
The public repository contains no private runtime defaults.
Queries are not persisted by the product.
Tracked files and Git history are scanned before publication.
Future model synthesis must be separately opt-in and tool-less.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Do all behavior and contract tests pass?
Is critical behavior covered?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Line coverage is at least 90 percent.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Is retrieval fast enough for Raycast?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Warm p95 is below 1000 ms on the target Mac.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Is the public history free of private artifacts and secrets?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Tracked-file and Git-history audits report no blockers.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Can the retriever mutate the projection or canonical vault?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Connections are immutable and query-only, and mutation regression tests pass.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Can a fresh clone be understood and validated?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: README and onboarding commands are complete and make check passes.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Is repository work durable and claimable?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: The exact repo-local Go stack validates with ordered open tasks.

review_checklist: Does the change preserve read-only vault authority?
Does retrieval remain general rather than entity-specific?
Are output states, citations, privacy boundaries, and residual risks explicit?
Do make check and the public repo-complete profile pass?
Are claims backed by tests, runtime evidence, or remote readback?

maturity_model.meaning: Vision, architecture, public-safety, and evidence contracts exist.
Schemas, behavior, privacy, and presentation are validated locally.
The CLI and Raycast adapter query a fresh real projection read-only.
Public metadata, release artifacts, and clean remote state are independently readable.

residual_risk_wording: Deterministic retrieval returns inspectable evidence rather than a conversationally synthesized answer; optional synthesis remains unimplemented and must not be implied by version 0.1.
